title: {Syn} AlphaFold2 Turned Protein Structure Into an AI Landmark
content:
AlphaFold2 achieved a major advance in predicting protein structures from amino-acid sequences, with results presented at CASP14 in 2020 and published afterward.

The work mattered because protein shape is closely tied to biological function, and experimental structure determination can be slow and expensive.

Why it matters: ai papers keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
